mx.teacher_note: Shiny plastic is suitable for a cooking vessel because it conducts heat well.

intelligence.enrichment: Conduction is the transfer of heat from one point to another in a material. Metals transfer heat well, so metal spoons get hotter than wooden spoons in the same hot water and metal vessels are used for cooking; wood and plastic are poor conductors and are suitable for handles. A material's ability to transfer heat determines whether it should be used where heating is needed or where heat protection is needed. The learner correctly applies this rule: Conduction is the transfer of heat from one point to another in a material. Metals transfer heat well, so metal spoons get hotter than wooden spoons in the same hot water and metal vessels are used for cooking; wood and plastic are poor conductors and are suitable for handles. A good cooking material should be used for every part of the utensil, including the handle.
